places.name: Antiguo Seminario Mayor de Comillas
places.booking: Can combine with Sobrellano; official site recommends 90–120 minutes between visit start times.

places.name: Arqueositio Cántabro-Romano de Camesa-Rebolledo
places.hours: Same standard seasonal pattern: low daytime hours; mid/high split day Tue–Sat; Sunday mornings; Mon closed. Weather can alter opening.
places.booking: Opening can change due to weather; check before travel.

places.name: Casas del Águila y la Parra

places.hours: Check current daily opening before travel; free admission. Best combined with Santillana del Mar.
places.booking: Currently free entry; pass gives no direct admission saving at current tariff.

places.name: Casona de Tudanca
places.hours: Year-round subject to published opening calendar; some periods require reservation at least a day ahead; Sundays free.
places.booking: Published tariff: adult €3; age 4–12 €1.50; under 4 free. Reservation required at least one day ahead in some periods; Sundays free.

places.booking: Opening can change due to weather; check before travel.

places.name: Ciudad romana y Domus de Julióbriga

places.booking: Check opening times before travel.

places.name: Cueva de Cullalvera
places.booking: Timed cave visit; check availability before travel.

places.booking: Timed visits; max 7 per session. Ticket includes Centro de Arte Rupestre.

places.booking: Timed guided visits; limited capacity. Advance booking recommended.

places.name: Cueva de Hornos de la Peña

places.booking: Very limited capacity (4 per session); advance planning strongly advisable.

places.hours: Same seasonal pattern as El Castillo; fixed sessions. Mon closed. Entry includes Centro de Arte Rupestre.
places.booking: Timed visits; max 7 per session. Ticket includes Centro de Arte Rupestre.

places.name: Museo de la Naturaleza de Cantabria
places.hours: Year-round museum; Sundays free. Check current seasonal timetable before travel.
places.booking: Normal €5 age 13+; reduced €3 age 4–12; age 0–3 free. Sundays free.

places.name: Museo de Prehistoria y Arqueología de Cantabria (MUPAC)

places.hours: Year-round museum; check current daily timetable before setting out.
places.booking: Check current reservation requirements; Sunday late afternoon may be free without the pass.

places.name: Museo Etnográfico de Cantabria
places.hours: Guided/free visits; check current schedule and reserve workshops/activities where required.
places.booking: Visits are reported as free and guided; workshops require reservation. No direct admission saving from the pass at current tariff.

places.name: Museo Marítimo del Cantábrico
places.hours: Year-round museum; current listing shows daytime opening (e.g. 10:00–18:00). Check official hours for chosen date.
places.booking: 2026 published tariff: adult €8; child 5–12 €5; under 5 free.
